# Transport

- TEF path: `1-transport`
- Sector key: `transport`
- Total transition elements: 72

## Routing Definition

Movement of people and goods, including road, rail, aviation, waterborne transport, freight, mobility, vehicles, fuels, and transport efficiency.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes passenger or freight movement.
- The initiative affects vehicles, buses, rail, aviation, shipping, roads, modal shift, charging for transport, or transport fuels.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative primarily changes energy generation or heat supply rather than transport demand or vehicles.

## Direct Subcategories

- `1-transport/1a-mobility`: Mobility (40 transition elements)
- `1-transport/1b-freight`: Freight (32 transition elements)
- `1-transport/1c-other`: Other (0 transition elements)

## Direct Transition Elements

- None directly under this category

# Industry

- TEF path: `2-industry`
- Sector key: `industry`
- Total transition elements: 24

## Routing Definition

Industrial production, process emissions, manufacturing, mineral production, chemicals, metals, product use, electronics, and industrial fuel or material shifts.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes industrial processes, materials, manufacturing, industrial heat, or industrial feedstocks.
- The initiative targets cement, steel, chemicals, minerals, metals, product use, or industrial production equipment.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative concerns residential/commercial building operation or municipal energy supply rather than industrial production.

## Direct Subcategories

- `2-industry/2a-minerals`: Minerals (6 transition elements)
- `2-industry/2b-chemicals`: Chemicals (5 transition elements)
- `2-industry/2c-metals`: Metals (6 transition elements)
- `2-industry/2d-other`: Other (7 transition elements)

## Direct Transition Elements

- None directly under this category

# AFOLU

- TEF path: `3-afolu`
- Sector key: `afolu`
- Total transition elements: 2

## Routing Definition

Agriculture, forestry, livestock, land use, land-use change, managed soils, cropland, forest land, wetlands, settlements land, and biomass-related land emissions.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes land management, forests, cropland, grassland, wetlands, livestock, manure, soils, fertiliser, or agricultural practices.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative is urban green infrastructure only when framed mainly as adaptation, public space, or building/energy work without land-use emissions relevance.

## Direct Subcategories

- `3-afolu/3a-livestock`: Livestock (1 transition elements)
- `3-afolu/3b-land`: Land (0 transition elements)
- `3-afolu/3c-aggregate-sources-other`: Aggregate Sources Other (1 transition elements)

# Buildings

- TEF path: `4-buildings`
- Sector key: `buildings`
- Total transition elements: 54

## Routing Definition

Residential and non-residential building energy demand, HVAC, lighting, appliances, equipment, construction, retrofits, and building stock changes.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes energy use or efficiency inside residential, commercial, institutional, or public buildings.
- The initiative targets retrofits, insulation, HVAC, lighting, appliances, construction, or building stock performance.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative primarily changes district heat or electricity supply outside the building, which may route to Energy.

## Direct Subcategories

- `4-buildings/4a-residential`: Residential (22 transition elements)
- `4-buildings/4b-non-residential`: Non Residential (29 transition elements)
- `4-buildings/4c-building-stocks`: Building Stocks (3 transition elements)

## Direct Transition Elements

- None directly under this category

card_text:
# Energy

- TEF path: `5-energy`
- Sector key: `energy`
- Total transition elements: 31

## Routing Definition

Energy supply, electricity, heat, combined heat and power, fuels, hydrogen, petroleum refinement, energy transformation, transmission, storage, and fugitive emissions.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes electricity generation, heat supply, district heating, CHP, hydrogen, fuel transformation, grid, storage, or energy supply mix.
- The initiative adds renewable generation, heat-pump-based heat supply, residual heat, solar farms, wind, biogas, or grid/storage infrastructure.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative only changes end-use building efficiency without changing energy supply.

## Direct Subcategories

- `5-energy/5a-energy-supply`: Energy Supply (24 transition elements)
- `5-energy/5b-energy-transformation`: Energy Transformation (7 transition elements)
- `5-energy/5c-energy-transmission-storage`: Energy Transmission Storage (0 transition elements)
- `5-energy/5d-other`: Other (0 transition elements)

## Direct Transition Elements

- None directly under this category

card_text:
# Waste

- TEF path: `6-waste`
- Sector key: `waste`
- Total transition elements: 4

## Routing Definition

Solid waste, wastewater, disposal, incineration, open burning, biological treatment, composting, landfill gas, recycling, and waste treatment changes.

## Use This Sector When

- The initiative changes waste collection, disposal, recycling, composting, wastewater treatment, landfill operations, or waste treatment emissions.

## Avoid This Sector When

- The initiative uses waste as an energy input and is primarily about energy supply; consider Energy as an alternative.

## Direct Subcategories

- `6-waste/6a-solids`: Solids (4 transition elements)
- `6-waste/6b-non-solids`: Non Solids (0 transition elements)
